- `src/explore_persona_space/task_workflow.py` (`recent_closed_workflow_fix_tasks`, the `hits.append` block): `closed.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")` formats — and the subsequent string sort orders — an aware datetime WITHOUT normalizing to UTC. An aware-but-non-UTC ts (e.g. `+02:00`) would print its local wall-time labeled `Z` and sort at the wrong position.
